title: From concept to Steam release with a bunch of friends
author: ImportantPie806
selftext:
Hi guys,

I had an idea for a small runner/auto battler game about a year ago, which I showed to a few friends. We started working on it together and it grew into a real game project.

![video](fdp7faf6hm2i1 "Starting concept")

We agreed to have absolutely no project management methods and just kind of auto steer into the direction that felt most comfortable. Too many scrum meetings and deadlines at work to introduce that shit into a hobby. Agreed to work on it consistently, but without deadlines or backlogs. That's probably why it took some time to get to the point where we are, but nonetheless we're launching early access on Steam tomorrow 20th of November.

We've had four people working on the game, who have appropriate skills and experience for game development while not being professionals at it. We've used AI tools pretty liberally excluding all the music and most sound effects, which our musician has produced the old school way.

It's been interesting to pivot our development approach multiple times as new tools and capabilities have been discovered. At first we had an idea of having an editor tool for many things such as quests, items, monsters, UI, etc. but at the end of the day everything has just come together faster by just utilizing ChatGPT's capabilities and not building heavy editor frameworks around the game.

We use ChatGPT for most of programming and technical design as well as pure concept art generation. Originally the 2d image sequences of hero and monsters, etc. were generated with Kling, but now Tripo 3D is a favourite tool for our graphics guy to turn concept images into 3d models that he animates, then turns back into 2d sequences for the game. A lot of manual Blender, Photoshop and After Effects labour is still invested for the visual end-result. Speech tracks have been mostly done with ElevenLabs. This post has been generated by myself which was tedious and probably would've made more sense if AI generated.

![video](ch3k3mhfim2i1 "Current gameplay promo stuff")

The actual game is at the moment pretty slow-paced and maybe not filled with insta dopamine all the time and we're interested to see if a more slow and challenging idle game will generate any traction at all.

I'd be very grateful if some of you guys try it out and give honest feedback on it.

Happy to discuss any and all aspects of developing the game as well.

Not sure which tag I'm supposed to choose so to be safe, I will tag this as self-promo. Here's the Steam link to Early Access if you're interested: 

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5533130/Apocalypse\_LootRunner/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5533130/Apocalypse_LootRunner/)
